tool_description: 宏基因组长读段组装与MAG分析流程（CycloneSEQ平台）
tool_description_en: Long-read metagenomic assembly and MAG analysis (CycloneSEQ)

tool_workflow_Desc: 测序数据质控：调用Rosa评估原始与清洗后测序数据的读长分布、GC含量和质量值分布等质量信息
测序数据预处理：根据设定的最小读长和最低质量阈值过滤低质量读段，可选对原始数据抽样和宿主基因组去除
宏基因组组装与抛光：调用metaFlye等组装工具构建宏基因组组装序列，可选额外使用短读段数据对组装结果进行抛光
分箱与基因组质量评估：调用Semibin2和CheckM2对组装结果进行分箱并评估MAG的完整度与污染度
MAG物种注释与丰度评估：对MAG进行物种分类与丰度估计，并生成综合分析报告
tool_workflow_Desc_en: Sequencing data QC: Use Rosa to evaluate read length distribution, GC content and base quality distribution for both raw and cleaned data
Read preprocessing: Filter low-quality reads according to minimum read length and minimum quality thresholds, with optional downsampling and host genome removal
Metagenome assembly and polishing: Use metaFlye and related tools to assemble metagenomes, with optional polishing using short-read data
Binning and genome quality assessment: Use Semibin2 and CheckM2 to bin contigs and assess MAG completeness and contamination
Taxonomic annotation and abundance estimation: Perform taxonomic classification and abundance estimation of MAGs and generate a comprehensive analysis report
tool_input_Desc: 样本ID：分析样本的编号或名称，作为结果文件的前缀
样本类型：分析样本的类型，用于选择合适的分析模式
测序数据文件：待分析测序数据文件（fastq/fq格式）
宿主基因组序列文件：去除宿主序列所用的宿主基因组序列文件
抽样数据量：分析前随机抽取的总碱基数（bp）
最小读长与最低质量：测序数据预处理过滤阈值
可选是否在组装过程中启用抛光，以及可选择加入二代测序数据辅助抛光
线程数：分析使用的线程数
tool_input_Desc_en: Sample ID (used for naming output files)
Sample type: used to select appropriate analysis mode
Sequencing data file to be analyzed (fastq/fq)
Host genome sequence file for host read removal
Downsampling bases: total bases (bp) to randomly retain before analysis
Minimum read length and minimum quality: filtering thresholds for preprocessing
Optional polishing during assembly, with optional short-read data for polishing
Threads: number of threads used for analysis
tool_output_Desc: 分析结果综合报告（sample_CycMetaAsm_Report.html）：包含测序数据质控、组装与分箱质量评估、物种组成与丰度等信息的网页报告
分析结果汇总压缩包（sample_CycMetaAsm_Results.zip）：包含组装分箱MAG序列、质量评估结果以及物种注释与丰度结果等文件
tool_output_Desc_en: Comprehensive analysis report (Sample_CycMetaAsm_Report.html): includes sequencing data QC, assembly and binning quality assessment, taxonomic composition and abundance, etc.
Compressed output package (sample_CycMetaAsm_Results.zip): includes MAG sequences, quality assessment results, and files for taxonomic annotation and abundance estimation

tool_parameter.name: 样本ID
tool_parameter.desc: 样本名称（用于结果文件命名）
tool_parameter.desc_en: Sample name (used for naming output files)

tool_parameter.name: 样本类型
tool_parameter.desc: 选择样本类型，以便分析选择合适的模式（global类型用于非特定类型样本）
tool_parameter.desc_en: Select sample type to choose appropriate analysis mode (use 'global' for non-specific samples)

tool_parameter.name: 测序数据文件
tool_parameter.desc: 待分析的测序数据文件（fastq/fq格式，支持.gz压缩）
tool_parameter.desc_en: Sequencing data file to be analyzed (fastq/fq, .gz supported)

tool_parameter.name: 随机抽样数据量
tool_parameter.desc: 在分析前对原始数据随机抽取的总碱基数（bp），空则不抽取
tool_parameter.desc_en: Total bases (bp) to randomly retain before analysis; no sampling if unset

tool_parameter.name: 宿主基因组序列
tool_parameter.desc: 用于宿主去除的宿主基因组序列（fasta格式文件)。默认提供人源基因组；若无需去除宿主序列需留空
tool_parameter.desc_en: Host genome reference for host read removal (FASTA file). Default is human genome; leave empty if no host removal needed

tool_parameter.name: 最小读长
tool_parameter.desc: 预处理过滤时保留的最小读长（bp）
tool_parameter.desc_en: Minimum read length (bp) kept during preprocessing

tool_parameter.name: 最低读段质量
tool_parameter.desc: 预处理过滤时保留的最低平均读段质量
tool_parameter.desc_en: Minimum mean read quality kept during preprocessing

tool_parameter.name: 启用抛光
tool_parameter.desc: 是否在组装后启用抛光步骤（不提供二代数据则仅进行长读段自我抛光，若提供则进行2+3抛光）
tool_parameter.desc_en: Whether to enable polishing after assembly (optional; self-polishing with long reads only if no short reads provided, otherwise 2+3 polishing)

tool_parameter.name: 短读段R1文件
tool_parameter.desc: 用于抛光的二代短读段测序数据R1文件（可选，与R2同时设置）
tool_parameter.desc_en: Short-read sequencing data R1 file for polishing (optional; should be set together with R2)

tool_parameter.name: 短读段R2文件
tool_parameter.desc: 用于抛光的二代短读段测序数据R2文件（可选，与R1同时设置）
tool_parameter.desc_en: Short-read sequencing data R2 file for polishing (optional; should be set together with R1)

tool_parameter.name: 物种注释参考数据库
tool_parameter.desc: 物种注释参考数据库（文件夹路径）。

tool_parameter.name: 线程数
tool_parameter.desc_en: Number of threads used for analysis

tool_parameter.name: 报告配置文件
tool_parameter.desc: 报告模板配置文件（内部参数，对前端不可见）
tool_parameter.desc_en: Report template configuration file (internal parameter, hidden from frontend)

tool_parameter.name: sequencing_tech
tool_parameter.desc: 内部参数：测序平台类型，使用默认值即可
tool_parameter.desc_en: Internal parameter: sequencing technology, use default value

tool_parameter.name: assembler
tool_parameter.desc: 内部参数：组装软件类型，使用默认值即可
tool_parameter.desc_en: Internal parameter: assembler type, use default value

tool_parameter.name: checkm2_db_path
tool_parameter.desc: 内部参数：CheckM2 数据库根目录路径，由运行环境预先配置
tool_parameter.desc_en: Internal parameter: path of CheckM2 databases, pre-configured by runtime environment

tool_parameter.name: classify_tool
tool_parameter.desc: 内部参数：MAG物种注释工具，使用默认值即可
tool_parameter.desc_en: Internal parameter: tool used for MAG taxonomic classification, use default value
